list.name: site
list.label: Sucursal
list.query: SELECT store_name AS __text, store_id AS __value FROM sites ORDER BY store_name

panels.title: Visitantes
panels.description: Personas que entraron a esta sucursal en el período.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(ins) AS "Visitantes" FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(sales)::float / NULLIF(SUM(visits), 0) AS "Conversión" FROM conversion_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

SELECT bucket_day AS time, (SUM(amount_minor_sale) - SUM(amount_minor_return))::float / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0) / 100.0 AS "Ticket" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tasa de captación
panels.description: Visitantes ÷ tráfico cercano (de los que se acercaron al local, qué porcentaje entró).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket_day AS time, SUM(ins)::float / NULLIF(SUM(shoppers), 0) AS "Captación" FROM turn_in_rate_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Esta sucursal vs la cadena
panels.description: Indicadores de esta sucursal como proporción del promedio de la cadena (1.0 = igual al promedio). Verde = por encima, rojo = por debajo.

targets.rawSql: WITH per_store AS (SELECT c.store_id, SUM(c.ins) AS visitantes, SUM(p.sales)::float/NULLIF(SUM(c.ins),0) AS conv, (COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_minor_sale),0)-COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_minor_return),0))/100.0/NULLIF(SUM(p.sales),0) AS ticket, SUM(c.ins)::float/NULLIF(SUM(w.shoppers),0) AS capt FROM counting_by_bucket_day c LEFT JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON c.store_id=p.store_id AND c.bucket_day=p.bucket_day LEFT JOIN wifi_ble_by_bucket_day w ON c.store_id=w.store_id AND c.bucket_day=w.bucket_day WHERE c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY c.store_id), ch AS (SELECT AVG(visitantes) ig, AVG(conv) cv, AVG(ticket) tk, AVG(capt) cp FROM per_store), me AS (SELECT * FROM per_store WHERE store_id='$site') SELECT 'Visitantes' AS "Indicador", me.visitantes/NULLIF(ch.ig,0) AS "vs cadena", 1 ord FROM me, ch UNION ALL SELECT 'Conversión', me.conv/NULLIF(ch.cv,0), 2 FROM me, ch UNION ALL SELECT 'Captación', me.capt/NULLIF(ch.cp,0), 3 FROM me, ch UNION ALL SELECT 'Ticket', me.ticket/NULLIF(ch.tk,0), 4 FROM me, ch ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Demografía de los visitantes
panels.description: Distribución de los visitantes por categoría etaria estimada (altura por estéreo).

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(ins_adult) AS "Adultos", SUM(ins_child) AS "Niños", SUM(ins_unknown) AS "Sin clasificar" FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date

panels.title: Embudo de conversión
panels.description: Embudo de esta sucursal: tráfico externo → tráfico cercano → visitantes → compradores. El área sin llenar = la caída entre etapas.

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(w.passersby) AS passersby, SUM(w.shoppers) AS shoppers, SUM(c.ins) AS visitantes, SUM(p.sales) AS compradores FROM counting_by_bucket_day c FULL OUTER JOIN wifi_ble_by_bucket_day w ON c.store_id=w.store_id AND c.bucket_day=w.bucket_day FULL OUTER JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON COALESCE(c.store_id,w.store_id)=p.store_id AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day,w.bucket_day)=p.bucket_day WHERE COALESCE(c.store_id,w.store_id,p.store_id)='$site' AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day,w.bucket_day,p.bucket_day) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date) SELECT passersby AS "Tráfico externo", shoppers AS "Tráfico cercano", visitantes AS "Visitantes", compradores AS "Compradores" FROM t

panels.title: Perfil de afluencia — días de semana
panels.description: Visitantes promedio por hora del día (00-23), lunes a viernes del rango seleccionado.

targets.rawSql: WITH h AS (SELECT extract(hour FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int hr, ins FROM counting_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND extract(isodow FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <= 5) SELECT g AS "Hora", COALESCE(round(AVG(h.ins), 1), 0) AS "Visitantes" FROM generate_series(0,23) g LEFT JOIN h ON h.hr = g GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

panels.title: Perfil de afluencia — fin de semana
panels.description: Visitantes promedio por hora del día (00-23), sábados y domingos del rango seleccionado.

targets.rawSql: WITH h AS (SELECT extract(hour FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int hr, ins FROM counting_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND extract(isodow FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= 6) SELECT g AS "Hora", COALESCE(round(AVG(h.ins), 1), 0) AS "Visitantes" FROM generate_series(0,23) g LEFT JOIN h ON h.hr = g GROUP BY g ORDER BY g
